constraints.description: One create operation per callback-verified X account in each UTC calendar day; changing the principal or credential version does not reset the account-wide counter.
Read-only means the adapter-classified tweets.read and users.read operations only; search, streams, writes, and unknown X operations remain denied.
The gmail.v1 request rewrite limits the search to 30 days; this independent response proof requires every hydrated list result internalDate to be within the same 30-day window.
The gmail.v1 adapter additionally requires a successful detail response id to exactly equal the requested message_id and rejects internalDate values more than 300 seconds in the future.
Cumulative data-volume control for one Gmail list traversal: at most three pages, five minutes, 30 records, and 3 MiB of validated decoded response bytes.
Only the npm.registry adapter's closed write operations are admitted; the route-level JIT block separately requires one hardware-attested WebAuthn approval consumed at each forward start.
Credential use is allowed only during the declared UTC weekday intervals; this is a request-time gate, not a provider timestamp rule.
Monetary budget over the canonical integer amount field: no more than 100,000 cents across every trailing 86,400 seconds for the provider account.
